message.reasoning: We need to answer based on policy excerpts. The question: "Do automation rules and integrations migrate automatically with the plan change, or do they need to be manually reconfigured afterward?" This matches DOC-032 about plan migration: moving a workspace to a new plan does not interrupt existing API keys, webhooks or automation rules—they continue running, tied to workspace. Also tier-gated automation feature may pause if not available. So answer: they migrate automatically, no manual reconfiguration needed, except tier-gated features may pause. Provide short answer. Use post_reply.

function.arguments: {"message":"When you move a workspace to a different plan, all existing API keys, webhooks and automation rules keep working automatically – they’re tied to the workspace, not the plan tier, so you don’t need to re‑configure anything after the migration. The only exception is a rule that relies on a feature that’s only available in the destination tier; such a rule will be paused (not deleted) until the workspace is on a tier that includes that capability."}
